character.tara.name: Tara
memory.captain.postcards.description: I doubt Terence will become a regular at my temple. His soul belongs to a god of the sea.
memory.captain.postcards.title: I Salute Him
memory.eddi.intro.description: I think I have found the first worshipper of my new temple of knowledge. We may even become friends.
memory.eddi.intro.title: Meeting Eddy
memory.millie.intro.description: This girl reminds me of Yuki. Millie has a thousand inspiring ideas and funny stories.
memory.millie.intro.title: An Open Soul
memory.owner.book_boxes.description: I buy books and I sell them. It is not that simple. What I really do is find them a new home - one where they will be loved.
memory.owner.book_boxes.title: Keeper Of Books
memory.owner.cafe.description: My first walk to the market square. The woman at the cafe carries offerings no one asked for, and they thank her for it. The ginger one knows the way better than I do.
memory.owner.cafe.title: Nobody Here Knows Me
memory.owner.col1.description: Yuki plays at being human sometimes and sweeps the yard. No point. People rarely wander into the shrine.
memory.owner.col1.title: Empty But Tidy
memory.owner.col2.description: She has learned to change shape. Yesterday a schoolgirl, today a grown woman, tomorrow a raccoon. Let her play. She is only four hundred.
memory.owner.col2.title: Energy And Chaos
memory.owner.col3.description: Five worshippers in a hundred years. Is there any sense in staying out here? No one comes to me for advice or help any more.
memory.owner.col3.title: Too Far Out Of The Way
memory.owner.moving_in.description: Leaving the place I had settled into was the best decision of my thousand-year life. Who said a god cannot choose its own home?
memory.owner.moving_in.title: No Fear Of Change
memory.owner.shop_cat.description: This ginger visitor turned up before the shop had even opened. Cats are new to my temple. Before, it was foxes and tanuki.
memory.owner.shop_cat.title: I'll Get Used To It
memory.owner.shop_items.description: An extraordinary feeling, spending coins you honestly earned. Nothing at all like conjuring illusions.
memory.owner.shop_items.title: Shopaholic
memory.tara.kids.description: Tara is always running somewhere. A huge list of plans and the will to get through all of it. Next to mine, a human life is short.
memory.tara.kids.title: Always In Motion
